_about: Positions decided by hand, each with its reason (28 Oct 2026). Everything else follows tools/positions.py: Wikidata where both helpers picked the same item; else Findlay 1887, else 1879.

spurn-point.note: The 1880s pair (high light of 1776, low light of 1851, 474 ft apart; Findlay) has no Wikidata item for the high light, demolished in 1895; one helper picked the surviving low light, the other none.

periods: The light on Lighthouse Island (Findlay 1879 'COPELAND', 1796), 0.14 km from Findlay's position.
Mew Island lighthouse, first lit 1884 (Findlay 1887 'MEW ISLAND', 1884), replacing it.

dursey-island.note: The temporary light on Dursey Island after Calf Rock lighthouse was destroyed in the gale of 26 Nov 1881 (Findlay 1887, under CALF ROCK); placed at Calf Rock's position, about 3 km off.

_extra: Entries with "wikidata_extra" take their coordinates from sources/lights/wikidata_extra_2026-10-28.json (the QID named).

south-gare.note: South Gare Lighthouse (lit 1884; Findlay 1887 gives no position); not in the lighthouse extract, found by name.

heligoland.note: Gätke's station: the island of Heligoland.

stevns.note: Stevns Lighthouse, Denmark ("Stevns Fyr, Zealand" in the master lists).

fair-isle.note: An observer on the island (no light until 1892): the island.

north-stack.note: The fog-signal station at North Stack, Holyhead: the islet of that name.

hynish-signal-tower.note: Hynish Harbour, Tiree: Skerryvore's shore station and signal tower.

teesmouth-1880.note: A second 1880 Teesmouth row with no type: the river mouth.

northrepps.note: A village near Cromer (1880 only): the village.

allonby.note: A village on the Solway (1881 only, C. Donald Thompson's): the village.

lundy-fog-signal.note: The fog-gun station on Lundy: the island.

faroe.note: An observer in the Faroes, place not given: the islands (very approximate).

tees-lv.note: The reports' 'Tees, 5 Buoy' light-vessel is Findlay's Tees entry (lights on the fourth and fifth buoys); one position for both editions (Findlay 1879 prints none).
